findings.title: README does not document applyMergePatch (JSON Merge Patch, RFC 7396)
findings.why: The change adds a public `applyMergePatch` export in `src/index.ts`, with `JsonMergePatchError` and an `openspec` spec. The README documents Pointer, Patch and createPatch but has no merge-patch section; a grep for 'merge' in README.md returns nothing. Consumers of this library cannot find the function or learn its semantics (a non-object patch replaces the target, `null` removes a member, invalid input throws `JsonMergePatchError`).

findings.title: Overlong line in the JSON Patch paragraph
findings.why: The sentence about malformed patches runs on as a single line, well past the ~110-column wrap used in the rest of the README, so it reads as an unwrapped edit.
